summary: While chanting, the bearer cannot be made Stopped, Frozen or Insubstantial, except by themselves or their own other Enchantments.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Does not prevent these States when caused by the bearer or by other Enchantments the bearer carries.

restrictions.note: Stopped, Frozen or Insubstantial caused by the bearer or by other Enchantments the bearer carries are not prevented.

termination.note: Must follow all Chant rules; the Enchantment ends when the Chant stops.

properties.note: Chant "Song of Freedom" or sing a song of roving or rambling.

references.name: enchantments
references.note: States from the bearer's other Enchantments are not prevented.

clarifications.text: Singing in place of the normal Chant is still a Chant and must follow all Chant rules (stopping the Chant ends the song).
Stopped, Frozen or Insubstantial caused by the bearer themselves or by other Enchantments they carry still apply.

open_questions: E1 says 'cannot receive': read as prevention of new States only; the text does not say whether a State already held when the song starts is removed.
